title: Define canonical operation registry
summary: Extended the versioned canonical-operation registry with one authority-linked contract covering roles, lineage relations, ownership, law and witness refs, reverse meaning, motif requirements, pacing, static-cost roles, and fixtures; migrated core, generated algebra, semantic-motion, and LLM consumers; validated reverse closure and project extension packs; split a compact canonical-composition projection from the heavy registry so governed metadata stays off the initial render path and entry gzip remains 243.99 KB.
